title: Austin's Closed-Door Meeting: Legal, Land, Staff
summary:
*   Austin officials held a special, brief closed-door Executive Session for legal consultation.
*   Discussions focused on sensitive matters including land acquisitions, pending lawsuits, and personnel issues.
*   A specific lawsuit, *State of Texas v. City of Austin*, was among the legal items addressed.
*   No final decisions or public actions were taken during this short meeting.
